answer: Each identity binds to one state-licensed customs broker licence: the registry verifies licence, exam record and bond, rejecting duplicates — one licence per agent, sealed with a lotus watermark. It needs a 240-day apprenticeship, an exam and a 6,000-unit bond, so one fake costs 6,000 units and 240 days; 100 fakes cost 600,000 units and 24,000 days. Cheapest cheat: buy a retiring broker's licence — but the seller surrenders their own anchor, transfer costs 8,500 units plus a background check, and a forged certificate with a pigment stamp fails the exam check — no hollow shortcut survives.
